notes: Only metrics explicitly defined in this glossary should be treated as controlled business metrics.
A metric may only be suggested or used with dimensions listed in its valid_dimensions field.
A technically computable value is not automatically a supported business metric.

relative_time.last_month: The calendar month immediately before the analysis reference date.
relative_time.recently: Undefined in V1. Ask for clarification when the requested time period cannot otherwise be determined.

promotion_analysis.rule: The system may compare promoted and non-promoted transactional outcomes but must not claim that a promotion caused a change in sales.

undefined_metrics.profit: Generic profit is not a controlled V1 metric.
undefined_metrics.gross_profit: Product cost data exists, but gross profit is not supported until revenue, returns and cost-of-goods treatment are formally defined.
undefined_metrics.net_profit: Operating expenses, salaries, rent, taxes, marketing and other accounting costs are unavailable.
undefined_metrics.margin: Margin is not a controlled V1 metric.
undefined_metrics.return_rate: Return rate is not supported until a denominator and a mature observation window are formally defined.
undefined_metrics.repeat_purchases: Do not treat repeat_customer as repeat purchases or use it as a ranking metric.

return_observation.rule: Recent order cohorts may have incomplete return observation because returns can occur after the dataset end date.
return_observation.ranking_policy: Do not offer return rate as a ranking or clarification metric in V1.

gross_sales.definition: Total item value before discounts and refunds.
rules: Only completed orders are included.
Cancelled orders are excluded.

discount_amount.definition: Total discounts applied to completed order items.
rules: Only completed orders are included.
Cancelled orders are excluded.

refund_amount.definition: Total amount refunded for returned items.
rules: Refund records come from the returns table.
Direct refund-period analysis uses return_date.
This time basis is different from the order-cohort treatment used by net_revenue.

net_revenue.definition: Revenue from completed orders after item discounts and refunds attributable to those order items.
rules: Cancelled orders are excluded.
Revenue in this project means net_revenue unless the user explicitly asks for gross_sales.
For a selected period, qualifying completed orders are selected using orders.order_date.
Refunds linked to items from those qualifying orders are subtracted regardless of the refund return_date.
This is an order-cohort revenue definition, not accounting-period revenue by refund date.
Recent order cohorts may have incomplete future-return observation near the dataset end date.

order_count.definition: Number of distinct completed customer orders.
rules: Cancelled orders are excluded.
Product-level and category-level order_count attribution is not a controlled V1 definition.

average_order_value.definition: Average net revenue generated per qualifying completed order.
rules: Cancelled orders are excluded.
Product-level and category-level average_order_value are not controlled V1 definitions.

gross_units_sold.definition: Total item quantity on completed orders before accounting for returns.
rules: Only completed orders are included.
Cancelled orders are excluded.
Returned quantities are not subtracted.
Use the name gross_units_sold so the treatment of returns is explicit.

repeat_customer.definition: A customer with at least two completed orders in the selected analysis period.
rules: The selected analysis period must be applied before counting orders.
This is a customer classification, not a repeat-purchase ranking metric.

active_customer.definition: A customer with at least one completed order in the selected analysis period.
rules: The selected analysis period must be applied before counting orders.
This is a customer classification rather than a ranking metric.
